gloss: last working day of the year

definitions.gloss: last working day of the year; year-end work close
definitions.explanation: The final day of work before the New Year holiday. For most Japanese companies and government offices, this is December 28.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}が{仕事納|しごとおさ}めだ。
examples.english: Today is the last working day of the year.

examples.japanese: {仕事納|しごとおさ}めの{日|ひ}は{早|はや}めに{退社|たいしゃ}できる。
examples.english: On the last working day of the year, you can leave early.

examples.japanese: {仕事納|しごとおさ}めの{後|あと}、{職場|しょくば}の{仲間|なかま}と{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: After the last day of work for the year, I went to a year-end party with my colleagues.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Most Japanese companies and government offices close for the New Year holiday from December 29 through January 3. {仕事納|しごとおさ}め is typically December 28. The opposite is {仕事始|しごとはじ}め (first working day of the new year), usually January 4.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕事納|しごとおさ}めの{日|ひ}: the last working day of the year
- {今年|ことし}の{仕事納|しごとおさ}め: this year's last working day

FORMS:
{仕事|しごと} (work) + {納|おさ}め (closing, ending).
